description: This file defines the authentication route handlers for a Node.js/Express backend, including user registration, login, retrieval of current user info, and logout, utilizing associated user and activity models as well as authentication middleware.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles registration of a new user, creating user and activity records, and issuing an authentication token.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, logs activity, and returns a token and user info.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Returns information about the current user based on the token provided.

methods.name: POST /auth/logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by recording activity; functionally stateless for the server.
